text:
alex: FYI rolled bmc-fw v2.14 to eu3-rack-4 and eu3-rack-5 ~21:02 UTC. Shortly after, 3 nodes reported secure boot = enabled and failed PXE provisioning. provisioning queue started piling up.:eyes:
maria: which hosts?
alex: eu3-4a02, eu3-4a03, eu3-5b01. Logs show OOB agent re-applied NVRAM vars during the flash step. sample: ```Sep 14 21:03:12 eu3-4a02 oob-agent[4123]: write_efi_var(TPM, SecureBoot=1) -> OK```
jin: seeing GPU pod evictions and node drain in eu3, cluster capacity down ~12%. Autoscaler tried to spin up replacements but quota limits prevented new reserved nodes. We failed over some jobs to us-west on-demand GPUs — cost jump reported.
samir: can we flip the efivar back remotely or do a rollback of fw?
ops-runner: scheduled action: canary-rollback eu3-rack-4 initiated by alex at 21:14 UTC :construction: (task id: rollback-212345)
maria: quick check: ipmitool and vendor tools show BMC applied a flag change right after flashing. ipmi sel snippet: ```SEL# 1 | 21/09/14 21:03:12 | System Event| Intelligent Platform Mgmt: EFI var changed```. Looks like the vendor fw writes a default SecureBoot=1 if some sanity check fails.
jin: consequence: several GPU jobs were preempted; autoscaler fallback policy routed work to us-west. Cloud billing alert fired, estimate +$2.3k for the hour (on-demand GPU instances). :money_with_wings:
alex: mitigation steps taken: 1) paused remaining eu3 rollouts, 2) kicked canary rollback on rack-4 (ops-runner), 3) added a temporary static provisioning pool for critical ML jobs pinned to remaining healthy nodes, 4) disabled autoscaler cross-region fallback for critical queues.
samir: rollback completed on eu3-rack-4 at 21:21 UTC according to ops-runner. eu3-4a02 and eu3-4a03 rebooted and rejoined with SecureBoot=0. eu3-5b01 still unstable — hardware team investigating.
maria: opened INC-2026-0341 and added cost impact + job failure summary. tagging infra@, fw-vendor@ for follow-up.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0341 created and acked by oncall. Slack incident channel: #inc-2026-0341
jin: immediate follow-ups (short): - add pre-flash step that snapshots efivars and verifies post-flash state - add alert when node secureboot state != expected - change autoscaler fallback to prefer same-region spare capacity before cross-region
alex: longer term: vendor engagement to get a fw patch that doesn't force efivar changes on minor sanity failures, and add BMC flash dry-run mode.
maria: cost rough math: +$2.3k on cloud GPUs + ~3 engineer-hours (oncall + rollback) ~= ~$5k impact. I'll put that in the postmortem.
samir: creating a small tool to batch-check efivars across fleet, will PR by tomorrow.
ops-runner: note: canary disabled for remaining eu3 racks until vendor fix confirmed.
alex: assigning actions: maria -> postmortem + cost calc, jin -> autoscaler policy tweak + alert, samir -> efivar audit tool, alex -> vendor contact + fw reproduction environment. ack if got it.
maria: ack.
jin: ack.
samir: ack.
alex: thanks team — will follow up with vendor convo notes and timeline.
